claude_proposed_widenings.name: ignore_difficult_terrain
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Difficult Terrain immunity is a categorical movement-economy effect — not representable as modify_speed (additive) or any existing speed atom. The TAXONOMY survey already flagged 'difficult_terrain' (2 hits) as genuinely new atom pressure.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Difficult Terrain doesn't cost you extra movement.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: block_speed_reduction
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The ring prevents magic from reducing any of the wearer's Speeds. block_max_hp_reduction covers the analogous HP case but no parallel atom exists for speed. The source filter (magic-only) is also new — the existing speed atoms have no source-gating.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: magic can neither reduce any of your Speeds

claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_condition_immunity (with sourceFilter: 'magic')
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: grant_condition_immunity exists but is unconditional. The ring only blocks magic-sourced Paralyzed and Restrained; a physical grapple can still impose Restrained. Using the unconditional atom would overstate immunity. A sourceFilter field (e.g., 'magic') is needed.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: magic can neither... cause you to have the Paralyzed or Restrained condition
